**Pantone “Sky Blue”**

| Context | Typical Pantone Code |
|---------|----------------------|
| Standard “Sky Blue” used in design & printing | **Pantone 15‑3919** |

> *Note:*  
> - Pantone’s catalog contains several “blue” hues that resemble a clear daytime sky—e.g., Pantone 13‑4202 (“Soft Blue”) or Pantone 11‑4505 (“Very Light Blue”).  
> - If you’re working with digital media, you’ll often see the hex value `#87CEEB` (the CSS name “skyblue”), which corresponds roughly to Pantone 15‑3919 when converted via Pantone’s Color Bridge guide.

---

### Quick Reference – Hex ↔︎ Pantone

| Hex Value | Approximate Pantone Match |
|-----------|--------------------------|
| #87CEEB   | Pantone 15‑3919          |
| #ADD8E6   | Pantone 13‑4305 ("Baby Blue") |
| #BFEFFF   | Pantone 13‑4405 ("Powder Blue") |

If your project requires a very precise match—for instance, fabric dyeing versus screen print—the exact Pantone conversion will differ slightly due to material reflectance. Let me know if you’d like help selecting the best Pantone for a particular application!
